changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Tue 10, 2:20 PM)
items: Fishing is slightly worse than yesterday afternoon: no ground is GOOD any more, and the east side is wider. Fishing right now is 0 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 3 POOR / 6 VERY POOR (was 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 4 VERY POOR). Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo all slid from GOOD to MARGINAL (wind 12–15 kt, gusts 19–21, was 5–10 kt). Ciron and Barangonan fell to VERY POOR (22 kt), joining Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Alava. Culion, Linapacan and Binudac are POOR.

Regional wind: Wed 11 13 kt, gusts 20 (was 14 g21), Thu 12 13 kt, gusts 19 (was 14 g21), Fri 13 14 kt, gusts 21 (was 13 g19), Sat 14 8.9 kt (was 6.5), Sun 15 10 kt, Mon 16 11 kt, gusts 19. Supply outlook is unchanged: Thu 12 and Fri 13 stay SOFT. Shortage detector ELEVATED Wed–Mon; surge OFF.
